provenance.temperature_ev: Effective mean-I-V slope from the main repeated slow scan on page08; used as a Maxwellian temperature proxy, not a simultaneous bulk-temperature calibration.
provenance.magnetic_field: Reported local radial/axial component magnitudes at C1; their vector magnitude sets the electron gyrofrequency.
provenance.density_m3: Provisional order-of-magnitude value; not inferred by fitting the fluctuation spectra.
provenance.ion_mass_u: Assumed singly ionized xenon; replace if a different working gas is confirmed.
provenance.electron_drift_m_per_s: Provisional +100 km/s along model +y; not derived from the discharge voltage or measured cross phase.
provenance.k_parallel_debye: Illustrative finite-parallel-wave-number choice, also used in Brown and Jorns (2023); not a measured value for these captures.
provenance.wave_vector: Field-aligned slab: k_perp=ky, other perpendicular component zero, fixed k_parallel. The measured field is tilted; parallel is not identified with laboratory radial.
provenance.ion_doppler: Assume k dot u_i=0 in this illustrative cold-ion branch; this does not assert that the actual ion beam is stationary.
provenance.direction: Assume model +y and positive group velocity point from C1 to C3; propagation direction remains unmeasured.
provenance.response: No gain/delay correction, plasma-potential conversion, or inverse circuit filter.
provenance.scope: Single illustrative kinetic branch, not fitted mode identification or exhaustive root enumeration.

scope: Measured voltage coefficients, held-out moments, and explicitly assumed kinetic branch; no physical EDI identification.

analysis.q_map: mean magnitude over folds; symmetric ordered-pair convention
analysis.psd: page06 one-sided Hann-corrected Welch spectra, 16384 samples; equal capture average
analysis.half_power_transfer: matches Brown & Jorns Eq6 factor convention; full d|X|^2/dt contribution is 2T
